profile_text.body:
Stability AI is a for-profit startup founded in 2019 and headquartered in London, UK. Its site presents Clipdrop, an image editing suite whose tools include background removal, picture cleanup, upscaling, and Stable Diffusion. The company describes the suite as able to create visuals in seconds with AI, and it lists inpainting through the Cleanup tool as a free way to remove a person from a photo.

The tracked products are Clipdrop (Stability AI), described as an image editing AI suite within the Stability AI ecosystem with open-weight tools and commercial licensing, and Stable Diffusion, described as an open-weight image model. The site text also carries biographies of Clipdrop's co-founders: Cyril Diagne, an interaction designer and developer who was CEO until the acquisition; Jonathan Blanchet, who was CTO until the acquisition and is now vice president of engineering at Jasper.AI; and Damien Henry, who was COO and, following Clipdrop's acquisition in 2023, became senior vice president of product at Stability, then Jasper.

The record also lists five lawsuits involving the company: EVOX Productions LLC v. Stability AI, Inc. in the District Court, C.D. California; Anders v. Stability AI US Services Corporation in the District Court, W.D. North Carolina; Getty Images (US), Inc. v. Stability AI, Ltd. in the District Court, N.D. California; Getty Images (US), Inc. v. Stability AI, Inc. in the U.S. District Court, D. Delaware; and Andersen v. Stability AI Ltd. in the U.S. District Court, N.D. California.
